title: Shared-checkout commit collisions — pathspec discipline required
summary: Three near-collisions in one evening (2026-06-10) from concurrent background workers committing in the single shared ~/.claude/orchestrator checkout: (1) a worker's file-level git add swept another session's uncommitted daemon.js/overlay.js hunks (fixed via index plumbing), (2) a plain `git commit` swept another worker's staged smoke.sh into a skills commit (self-corrected), (3) the reverse sweep a minute earlier. Working rule for ALL workers in this checkout: commit via explicit pathspec (`git commit -- <own files>`) — `git diff --cached --stat` alone is not enough, the index can change between check and commit. Durable fix candidate for a future initiative: dispatch each worker into its own worktree via branch_task now that repo-target exists, instead of sharing the main checkout.
